title: Chapter 338 Zhao Bangde Vs Black Dragon King
content:
Chapter 338 Zhao Bangde Vs Black Dragon King

"Since you said I'm not sincere! Okay, then I'll show you the backbone of my human race."

"Black Dragon King, do you dare to accept me when I leave the city to fight?" Zhao Bangde was righteous and awe-inspiring, looking like he was ready to die.

Zhu Dongheng next to him was shocked: "Brother Zhao, no."

He spoke sincerely and had an anxious look on his face.

"It doesn't matter, I also want to try to see how powerful this senior warrior is." Zhao Bangde looked calm, but his eyes were firm.

"Chief, no!" The four commanders of Shanhai City immediately knelt down and begged.

"Hahaha... Okay, Commander Zhao, your courage deserves a high look from me."

"If there were more people like you before our Black Dragon City was destroyed, the original battle probably wouldn't have ended like this!"

After saying that, his eyes showed overwhelming hatred.

"Anna, sooner or later I will pay back a hundredfold the pain I have endured for thousands of years."

Zhao Bond glanced at everyone and gave them a reassuring look.

Then, regardless of everyone's dissuasion, he jumped off the more than 30-meter-high city wall.

"Black Dragon King, I have already left the city, how about we fight here?"

"Why not?"

The Black Dragon King relied on the strength of his senior general to deal with a small mid-level general, without any reason to be afraid.

He circled in the air, then swooped down.

Zhao Bondang frowned and frowned, holding his breath and waiting for the Black Dragon King to approach.

He made fists with both hands, ready to go.

When the dragon's head was about to approach, his legs suddenly exerted force, bent slightly, and then like an arrow from the string, he rushed towards the Black Dragon King in the sky.

Wang Shuo was so excited that he didn't even dare to breathe.

The huge gap in strength did not allow Zhao Bond to give in at all, but instead fought back.

It made countless soldiers feel tragic.

The fist hit the dragon's head. Not only did it fail to repel the Black Dragon King, but Zhao Bond was knocked away dozens of meters and hit the city wall directly.

"The mantis is trying to block the car, but he is overestimating his own abilities."

The Black Dragon King looked at the overestimating Zhao Bond and laughed wildly.

Being able to kill the enemy's senior generals effortlessly is a huge profit no matter what.

At the same time, Zhao Bond's body was vomiting blood after hitting the city wall.

He climbed up with difficulty, but a smile appeared on his face.

"hehe."

After laughing a few times, he spat out another mouthful of blood.

"why are you laughing?"

The Black Dragon King is a little confused.

He immediately waved his two black claws, rushed over, grabbed Bond Zhao, and was about to tear him in half.

Zhao Bond did not resist and struggle.

Suddenly, the Black Dragon King's whole body began to tremble violently, and black energy overflowed from his body.

He took advantage of the last bit of fierceness to tear Zhao Bond into pieces, but there was no sight of blood and flesh flying everywhere as he had imagined.

Zhao Bond's body gradually blurred and disappeared.

The Black Dragon King was in a state of madness and couldn't help but roll on the ground.

It was obvious that he was feeling very uncomfortable at this time.

"Ah, what on earth did you do to me?"

The Black Dragon King roared wildly, causing sand and rocks to fly on the ground.

Zhao Bangde's figure appeared in Nanxuanfu City. He came to the city gate tower again and said lightly: "Black Dragon King, the taste of soul poison is not bad!"

Wang Shuo also breathed a sigh of relief, this is only reasonable!

As the lord of a county, how could he not have any means of resurrection?

But, what is the poison of the soul?

"Ah, a young man like you actually dares to plot against me."

The Black Dragon King struggled to speak.

"Black Dragon King, you are never tired of deceit. There are no specific methods for war."

Only then did everyone understand that Zhao Bangde had exchanged a chance for resurrection for the Black Dragon King's serious injury.
